digest.component_or_area: agent-call seam memoization and nudge wrapper
propositions: Allowlisted read-only tool calls (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) should be memoized at the agent-call seam so identical signatures return cached results without re-executing the tool.
Error-prefixed result strings are not memoized and must re-execute on retry, but deterministic sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)' are cached to prevent pathological loops.

Duplicate tool calls should trigger escalating static nudge text (level-1 on first repeat, level-2 on subsequent repeats) to steer the model away from looping before the runaway guard abortion backstop.
The runaway guard wrapper must remain outermost and continue to observe all memoized duplicates in its distinct-ratio window unchanged.
Non-allowlisted or write-bearing tools like record_criterion_verdict must never be memoized and always execute normally.
